prompt: The daily high temperatures (°F) in a town one week were $58, 63, 71, 66, 74, 60$ and $69$. What is the range of the temperatures?
hint: Range $=$ maximum $-$ minimum. It is a single number, not "58 to 74".

hints.text: Range $=$ maximum $-$ minimum. It is a single number, not "58 to 74".
Find the hottest and coldest days: $74$ and $58$.

explanation: The largest value is $74$ and the smallest is $58$.
The range is the simplest measure of spread, though it depends only on the two extremes.

alternativeExplanations.title: Sort first
steps: The ends are 58 and 74, so the range is $74 - 58 = 16$.
